about: The message a session is given about its background work (loop.json jobs.marks), composed from a job's record: `kind` command or subagent; `id`; for a command its `command`, `exit` (a number, or null when it was stopped by a signal), `seconds` run and `unread` output (the last note_tail_chars of it, an ellipsis before a cut); for a subagent its `agent`, `description`, `report` (empty: "(the subagent returned no report)"), `steps`, `tools`, `reason` (stop, stopped, steps, budget, or error with `error` text), `seconds`, and `worktree` (a summary line, or absent); for a message from a subagent (`kind` message) its `agent`, `description` and `text`; for one to a subagent (`kind` to_subagent) the `text`. The result is `text`: the mark on the first line, then the note. Durations as both projects write them ("5s", "1m 05s", "2h 03m"). LLeMbas: services/jobs.py note; CLI: jobs/note.ts jobNote.
